title: Streamlining Cathodoluminescence Data Collection and Analysis Using Autonomous Control
content: Cathodoluminescence (CL) is a powerful tool for studying semiconducting materials and devices thanks to the high excitation energy and high spatial resolution of the electron probe. The ability to directly correlate CL to other signals generated simultaneously can also aid in interpreting any collected data. However, CL studies can be time consuming in both the collection and analysis of data. This has presented a significant challenge to the adoption of the CL technique especially in industrial applications where high throughput is necessary. To meet this demand new approaches must be developed.
